title: Turned Away Quietly
description: A rejected login shouldn't dump you back at a blank form wondering what happened, and it definitely shouldn't say whether the email exists. Confirm the error surfaces clearly, in place, without navigation.
successCondition: Submitting /login with a wrong password for a seeded account renders a visible Alert (role="alert") on the same page with a generic message that does not reveal whether the account exists, the browser URL remains /login, and the email/password fields retain whatever was typed (not cleared).
hints: The login form has noValidate set, so the browser's native validation UI won't intercept a bad submission — the app's own Alert is what you're checking.
Try both a nonexistent email and a wrong password for a real account — the message text should read the same either way.
